title: CppCon 2015: Bjarne Stroustrup “Writing Good C++14”
summary: Bjarne Stroustrup's CppCon 2015 keynote on using C++14 to write better code, not just different code. It introduces the C++ Core Guidelines and the machine-checkable rules and GSL library behind them.
why: HN people recommend it as the starting point for modern C++ and for the language's safety story.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: If you want to start with modern c++ watch this
